purpose: Improve clarification value with bounded evidence from the current successful candidate pool, without changing intent parsing, retrieval, ranking, slate selection, or exact-reuse orchestration.

allowed_development_inputs: catalog field schema and individual synthetic catalog records
synthetic intent states, candidate partitions, and failures
forbidden_design_or_policy_inputs: targets, target ranks, hit outcomes, or simulator state
public answer, miss, attribute, cache, or scenario distributions
multiple candidate formulas followed by public-set selection
non_overfit_boundary.one_shot_rule: Freeze the sole formula, constants, tests, sources, and implementation lock before one public comparison. If any gate fails, retain Phase 7 and do not tune Phase 8 from public misses.

frozen_components.retrieval_routes: BM25 Top-100 plus BGE-small dense Top-100

candidate_change.scope: question selection only, plus an immutable compact catalog-facet side index
candidate_change.incumbent_first: Compute the exact incumbent choice before considering candidate evidence and return it on every guard or failure.
candidate_change.candidate_source: At most the first 64 IDs of a complete, successful, pre-slate Stage-A ranking. Never use the displayed slate, fallback output, partial ranking, target membership, labels, profiles, or outcomes.
candidate_change.ordinary_recommendation_invariant: Question selection occurs after the frozen recommendation computation and cannot alter current-turn ordered recommendations.
candidate_change.calibration_claim: Candidate separation is a deterministic diversity-and-coverage heuristic, not expected information gain, an answerability probability, ranking confidence, or success probability.

facet_contract.representation: One row-major unsigned 32-bit code per catalog row and attribute; zero means missing and positive codes are collision-free equality classes interned deterministically in catalog order.
facet_contract.builder_maps: Transient value-to-code maps are discarded after the single catalog pass.
facet_contract.normalization: NFC Unicode, control-character removal, whitespace collapse, and case folding; attribute-specific fixed aliases only.

extraction.feature: First explicit special-feature detail, otherwise the first normalized features-list item.
extraction.material: First exact material, material-type, fabric-type, outer-material, inner-material, or sole-material detail; otherwise a fixed generic material lexicon over bounded title/features/description text.
extraction.color: First exact color detail; otherwise a fixed generic color lexicon over bounded title/features/description text, with grey canonicalized to gray.
extraction.style: First exact style, fit, pattern, closure, neck, sleeve, or theme detail.
extraction.size: First exact size, size-name, shoe-size, or apparel-size detail; package/product dimensions and generic operational measurements are excluded.
extraction.use_case: First exact recommended-use, specific-use, occasion, sport-type, or sport detail.

facet_contract.multiple_values: A product contributes at most one canonical signature per attribute. Conflicting or extra values are not multiplied into evidence.
facet_contract.malformed_input: Malformed or oversized facet metadata becomes missing and never affects catalog loading, retrieval, ranking, or recommendations.
forbidden_facet_sources: queries, messages, profiles, targets, labels, or outcomes

evidence_contract.coverage_rule: After singleton values are removed, supported_candidate_count * 2 must be at least candidate_count.
evidence_contract.formula: For supported value counts c_v and C=sum(c_v), S=C^2-sum(c_v^2). S is the ordered-pair count for two candidates that both expose repeat-supported values and have different values.
evidence_contract.eligibility: At least two supported values, majority supported coverage, and S greater than zero.
evidence_contract.selection: Choose the eligible unresolved attribute with maximum S; exact ties use incumbent priority.

priority_barriers.open_ended_barrier: When other is the incumbent, return other exactly and do not let numeric evidence leapfrog it.
priority_barriers.final_barrier: Budget remains the exact incumbent fallback and receives no fabricated price evidence.
priority_barriers.interruption_rule: An unresolved interrupted question is returned before candidate evidence.
priority_barriers.resolved_rule: Resolved, no-preference, and previously asked attributes remain ineligible exactly as in the incumbent.

runtime_and_failure_contract.search: Use evidence only after both frozen routes are ok or empty, fallback is false, candidate documents are complete, Stage-A succeeds, and the entire ranking is normalized and unique.
runtime_and_failure_contract.reuse: Use the exact cached pre-slate ranked IDs and recompute only bounded integer counters from the immutable facet-code store; do not fetch documents or retain a second session cache.
runtime_and_failure_contract.skip: For top_k at or below zero, turn 10, or an empty ranked pool, do not request facet evidence.
exact_fallback_conditions: retrieval exception, route fault, or fallback
reranker skip, failure, or partial result

extractor_cells: case, whitespace, Unicode, and grey aliases
integration_cells: pre-slate pool rather than displayed page
same ranking with advancing question history
required_fallback_equivalence: retrieval, reranking, and candidate-document call counts
synthetic_confirmation.required_changed-question_invariant: Current-turn ordered recommendations equal the incumbent exactly.

execution.order: contract, implementation, synthetic tests, complete unit suite, implementation lock, one unlabeled backend warm-up, Phase 8 candidate, Phase 7 comparator, exact Phase 8 replay, then independent starter.Agent verification
execution.parallelism: strictly sequential for all model and evaluator work

promotion_gate.scenario_metrics: publish as aggregate diagnostics only; do not use small public subgroups as tuning or promotion vetoes
